Forms are essential for gathering and organizing information related to quality assurance
and monitoring student progress. They ensure compliance with graduate school policies
and facilitate clear communication between departments and the ESF graduate school.

New Faculty Information
There are currently five types of graduate degrees offered at ESF. Forms are organized
by degree program, select your program to skip to that section. All forms are in PDF
format unless indicated otherwise.
Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)
Master of Science (M.S.)
Master of Forestry (M.F.)
Master of Landscape Architecture (M.L.A.)
Master of Professional Studies (M.P.S.)
General Forms
Full-Time Status Form
(this form is to be completed by Masters students in their final semester or PhD students
who have passed candidacy exams who are enrolled for less than full time AND who are
not currently appointed as a Graduate Assistant (GA) or Research Project Assistant
(RPA). This form needs to be completed each semester.)
Petition for General Procedure
Petition for Extension of Time Limit for Degree Completion
Re-enrollment Form
(this form is to be completed by ESF Graduate students who were not enrolled during
the immediate past one or two semesters and who wish to continue in the program(s)
they were last registered)
State-Funded Graduate Assistantship Resignation Form
